chapter.verse: Tua lai takin ka et leh, Zion Mual tungah ding-in a om Tuuno-a kipan amau taltang tung uhah Tuuno’ min tawh, ama Pa’ min tawh kigelha a om mi sangkhat-thenli-tulli amah tawh a om ka mu hi.
Tua lai takin vantung pan tui tampi ging bang ahi zongin, vanging bang ahi zongin aw khat ka za hi. Ka zak aw in gawsem tumte’ gawsem tum aw tawh kibang hi.
Tua mite in tokhom mai-a ganhing lite leh upate mai-ah la thak a sa uh hi. Tua la thak zong leitung pana lei khitsa tua mi sangkhat-thenli-tullite sim loh kuamah in a sin thei kei uh hi.

Tua mite ahih uh leh, tangval ahi uh a, numei tawh khialhna nin a nei ngei lo ahi uh hi. Amaute in Tuuno paina teng a zui mite ahi uh hi. Pasian ading leh Tuuno ading a gah masa bel ahih nadingun mite lak pan a kilei mite ahi uh hi.
Amaute’ kam sung uhah zuau thu a om kei hi. Amaute in mawhsak nading a om lo mi ahi uh hi.
Leitungah a teeng mite-a kipan gam khempeuh, nam khempeuh, pau khempeuh, pawl khempeuhte kiangah tawntung Lungdamna Thu hilh dingin vantungmi adang khat in vankim lai-ah a leeng ka mu hi.

Tua vantungmi in, “Pasian kihta un la, a vangliatna phat un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a thukhen ding hun a tungzo hi. Vantung, leitung, tuipi leh cikte a piangsakpa na bia un,” ci-in nakpi-in kiko-in a gen hi.
Tua nung ciangin nihna vantungmi in zui-in, “Nu leh pa’ khialhna tawh kipawl ama hehna leenggahzu mipawl khempeuh a dawnsak khuapi lian Babilon a cim zo hi! a cim zo hi!” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua nung ciangin thumna vantungmi khat in zui-in, “Mi khatpeuh mah in sahang leh ama milim bia-in, ama taltang tung ahih kei leh, a khut tungah ciamtehna a ngah leh,

Pasian’ hehna hai-ah a kihel khawm lo-a kikoih hehna leenggahzu tua mi in a dawn ding hi. Tua tham loin a siangtho vantungmite mai leh Tuuno’ mai-ah tua mi in mei leh kat tawh bawlsiatna a thuak ding hi.
Tua mite gimna a thuakna meikhu in a tawntungin a kahto hi. Sahang leh ama milim a bia mi, sahang min ciamtehna a ngah mite in sun tawh zan tawh khawl hun nei loin a om uh hi.”
Hih na-ah Pasian’ thukhamte leh Zeisu upna a zui misiangthote thuakna a om hi.

Tua lai takin, “Tu-a kipan Topa sungah a si mite in thupha ngahte ahi uh hi ci-in gelh in,” ci-in vantung pan hong gen aw ka za hi. Kha Siangtho in zong, “Tua thu a man hi. Tua mite in tua bang ciangin nasepna bei-in khawlna tawlngakna thu a ngah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute nasepna un zong amaute a zui ding uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua lai takin ka et leh, a kaang van meii ka mu hi. Tua meii tungah mihing tapa tawh kibang mi khat kham kumpilukhu a lu tungah khu-in, phiaukawi hiam tawi-in a tu hi.

Tua lai takin vantungmi khat biakinnpi sungpan paikhia-in meii tungah a tu mi kiangah, “Na phiaukawi sawl in la, at in. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, at hun tung zo a, leitung gah a min zo a, kuai gawp zo hi,” ci-in nakpi-in a kiko hi.
Meii tungah a tu mi in phiaukawi leitungah a khiatsuk leh, leitung in atsa a suak hi.
Tua nung ciangin adang vantungmi khat in, vantungah a om biakinnpi sung pan a hiam phiaukawi tawi-in a paikhia hi.

Tua tham loin, mei a uk vantungmi khat in biakna tau sung pan a pusuah khit ciangin, phiaukawi a tawi vantungmi kiangah, “Leitungah a om leenggahte pha takpi-in min zo ahih ciangin a bawkte at ding, la dingin na phiaukawi hiam sawl in,” ci-in a kiko khit ciangin,
tua vantungmi in ama phiaukawi leitungah a khiatsuk leh, leitungah a om leenggahte a at khit ciangin a cilna phual ahi Pasian’ hehna sungah a paai hi.
Tua leenggah in khua pua lam phualah kicil hi. Tua phual sungpan a pusuak sisan in tai zanih dongin sakol kamkaih banin a luang hi.
